stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Nȋnyedete Azizi tondŭ
aikaraga akenete hindi
ciothe.

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Ndokira kiroko ni ndi
thambaga uthiu.
Gacoka gamwetha
Azizi.

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Nŭŭ Azizi ndariyaga
thuiti yake.
Nagamaka nȋkȋ!

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Ni heyaga Azizi ihua.
Nŭŭ ndacokagia,
"Ngatho."

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Nȋ ndimuthambagia
agathera mbere ya
mami athambie.

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Azizi ndȋmŭȋkagira ngŭo
ndune tondŭ
ninyendete rangi
mutune.

stories.title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
stories.text:
Ndathȋe toro, Azizi
ndȋmŭkomagia
mwenaine haria ndȋ.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Uyῦ nῖ mwarῖmῦ
wakwa.
Etagῦo Mwarῖmῦ Njeri.
Ni anyedete mῦno.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Mwarῖmῦ Njeri
athomithagia ndemwa
na a, e, i, o, u.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Mwarῖmῦ Njeri nῖ
athothomi
atῦthῦmithetie marangi
mῦtῦne, bruu, grini na
mῦirῦ.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Tῦgῖkoma Mwarῖmῦ
Njeri nῖ atῦinagira
karuῖmbo kega.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Karῦῖmbo gaka nῖkῦ Mwarῖmῦ Njeri
atuinagῖra:
Kŏŏma mwana
Kŏŏma mwana
Mami ni egῦka
Kŏŏma, akῦrekere
Iria kŏŏma.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Jumatatu nῖ
atῦganagῖra tῦrῦgano
twa andῦ njorῦa.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Kerῖ, Mwarῖmῦ Njeri
atῦganagῖra ng’ano cῖa
atῦmia njorῦa.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Jῦma, Mwarῖmῦ Njeri
atuῖraga tugane ng’ano
ciitu.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
stories.text:
Mwarῖmῦ witῦ nῖῖ
mwega mῦno.
Ndaneneha, gwenda
gutwika ta Mwarῖmῦ
Njeri.
